== Summary ==
Lower-panel cutout of [[Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 4, Original)|Tarkin (V)]] before the 2016 erratum. The Players Committee published the slip in its 2016 combined virtual card sheet.

== Source ==
* Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222826id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/MasterList.pdf#page=24 Virtual Card Slips Master List], Set 4 Dark Side, PDF p. 24, bottom-right Tarkin panel. Archived 6 August 2016.
